admission.justification: Four regression tests prove the repair omits the removed closeout_door dataclass field, pre-validates and publishes the successor waiting door, and recovers an interrupted door write instead of leaving a half-applied reset.

applicability: Organizational completion repair of a closed-out worktree contract whose live closeout door is claimed.
conditions: The live closeout door is claimed by the active integrate generation being reset.
The reopened WorktreeContract omits retired fields and pre-validates the successor waiting door before writing the reset contract.
exclusions: Non-integrate closeout doors or unclaimed live doors, which are refused before mutation.
statement: Organizational completion repair resets only live WorktreeContract fields in _quality_repair_contract and publishes the validated successor waiting door through the closeout door journal with door-aware completion classification and interruption recovery.
title: Organizational completion repair publishes waiting door with recovery
